title: Definition of period
text: A function is periodic of period $$w$$ if $$p\left(x+kw\right)=p(x)$$ for all $$x$$, $$where$$ $$k$$ is a whole number.

title: Multiple periods
text: $$\tan(\theta)$$ is $$2\pi$$ and $$4\pi$$ periodic since it is the ratio of two $$2\pi$$ periodic functions. However, $$\tan(\theta)$$ is also pi periodic. Thus is it $$3\pi$$ periodic as well.
